title: Jerry-chine Gun
wikitext:
{{Infobox/Weapon |rarity = E |id=JERRY_STAFF |damage=80 |intelligence=200 |reforgeable = yes |enchantable = yes |museum = yes |museum_xp = 6 |museum_category = combat }} The '''Jerry-chine Gun''' is an {{Epic}} [[Weapon]] obtainable from [[Jerry Box]]es while [[Mayor Jerry]] is active. It fires Jerry bullets at a high rate. == Obtaining == The '''Jerry-chine Gun''' can be obtained from any [[Jerry Box]]. == Usage == {{ItemInfo |type = Sword |rarity = epic |damage = 80 |intelligence = 200 |item_ability_name = Rapid-fire |item_ability_activation = Right Click |item_ability_description = Shoots a Jerry bullet, dealing {{Red|500}} damage on impact and knocking you back.

Each shot costs {{Dark Aqua|+30 mana}} more than the previous, resetting after {{Green|4s}} of not firing. |item_ability_intelligence_scaling = 0.2 }} When used, it shoots bullets resembling Jerry heads in the direction the player is facing. It has a maximum fire rate of 5 per second{{Confirm}} and it has a 3° angle of spread. The bullets are destroyed on impact, dealing {{DamageType|magic|500+}} to enemies which are directly hit. If the user is within 2.5 blocks of the impact, they are knocked upwards 2.5 blocks and away in the flat plane up to 2.5 blocks. Shooting other players with the bullets has no effect. The ability costs {{Stat|mana|30}} to use, and increases by {{Stat|mana|30}} each shot. If 4 seconds pass without shooting, its {{Stat|mana cost}} resets to {{Green|30}}. == Essence Crafting == {{Essence Crafting |essence=Wither |type=weapon |5|10|25|50; 10000 coins|100; 25000 coins }} == Trivia == * The '''Jerry-chine Gun''' can shoot through 1-block thick walls. * The '''Jerry-chine Gun''' has the highest fire rate of any weapon in the game.{{Confirm}} * The user can scale flat surfaces and medium-sized walls with it by looking down and shooting at the ground. This property of the weapon can be used in the [[Maxor]] & [[Goldor]] boss fights in [[The Catacombs - Floor VII]], by scaling the walls to reach the crystals in the first phase and the second device in the third phase respectively. * Starring the '''Jerry-chine Gun''' makes it {{Soulbound|Co-op}}. *Before the ability {{AN|Gold's Power}} of the {{Item|Golden Dragon Pet}} was removed, it affected the '''Jerry-chine Gun'''. == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|2021/Jan 11|[[File:Gold Horse Armor.png|26px]] Added '''Jerry-chine Gun'''.}} {{History|2021/May 31|-4/s fire rate (from 9/s to 5/s).|Each shot now consumes 30 more mana than the previous one instead of being shot for 5 mana each shot with no increase. This resets after 4 seconds.|Changed from explosion (radius 2.5) to single-target damage.}} {{History|0.19.3|Improved the lore of the '''Jerry-chine Gun'''.}} {{History|Unknown|'''Jerry-chine Gun''' can no longer be [[Dungeon Item|dungeonized]].}} {{History|0.26|[[File:Jerry-chine Gun (v2).png|26px]] Added a custom texture for '''Jerry-chine Gun''' as part of the SkyBlock Resource Pack.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Swords}} [[Category:Jerry]]
